messages.subject: JPM 2025 summer analyst program
messages.body:
Jonathan,

My name is Carson Harris and I am investment banking analyst with JPM's energy coverage group in Houston. Your contact info was passed along with respect to the 2025 summer analyst recruitment process.

Let me know if you have some availability next week and happy to hop on the phone to discuss.

Carson

Carson Harris | Analyst | Energy Investment Banking | J.P. Morgan

messages.subject: Re: JPM 2025 summer analyst program
messages.body:
Hello Carson,

I appreciate you reaching out. I'd love to hop on a quick call with you and learn a little more about JPM's recruitment process. Here are some times that work for me next week:

Monday (1/22) : 3 - 6 pm & 7 pm onwards
Tuesday (1/23): 10 am - 1 pm & 5 pm onwards
Wednesday(1/24): 11 am - 2 pm & 3 pm onwards

Please let me know if any of these times are convenient for you. I look forward to speaking with you.

Best,
Jonathan

messages.subject: RE: [EXTERNAL]Re: JPM 2025 summer analyst program
messages.body:
How is tomorrow at 6pm? If that works for you please send a calendar invite and you can reach me at my cell below. Thanks.

Carson

messages.subject: Re: [EXTERNAL]Re: JPM 2025 summer analyst program
messages.body:
Carson – tomorrow at 6 pm works perfectly. I'll send you a calendar invite and look forward to speaking with you then.

Best,
Jonathan

messages.subject: Re: [EXTERNAL]Re: JPM 2025 summer analyst program
messages.body:
Hey Carson,

I really appreciate you taking some time to hop on a call with me tonight – you provided some very valuable insight as I navigate the recruitment process and begin to strategically choose between EBs/MMs/BBs. The details you offered regarding the significant responsibilities offered to analysts along with the ability to work closely alongside senior bankers at JPM Houston really excites me. I will be submitting my application in the coming days. To that end, I would greatly appreciate it if you could connect me with someone else from your office, or pass along their contact information, as I look to gain more insight. Thanks again!

Best,
Jonathan
